title: Completing and submitting the questionnaire
purpose: Give the employee the step-by-step questionnaire flow. Show the permit reminder at the end, discard answers that no longer apply on submission, and make the questionnaire read-only afterwards, with every derived result always taken from the latest answers.

stories.title: Remind employees to bring their permit on the first working day
stories.i_want: every non-Swiss employee and every employee living abroad to be reminded at the end of the questionnaire to bring their permit on the first working day
stories.so_that: fewer new employees forget their permit on day one ("Half of them forget"), without Lonio collecting any extra data
stories.priority_reason: HR asked for it explicitly and it fixes a recurring annoyance (half of the new employees forget their permit), but it blocks no registration.

acceptance_criteria.title: Reminder shown to non-Swiss employees living in Switzerland
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee whose home address is in Switzerland and whose nationality is not Switzerland
acceptance_criteria.when: they reach the end of the questionnaire, before submitting
acceptance_criteria.then: Lonio shows the reminder to bring their permit on the first working day

acceptance_criteria.title: Reminder shown to every employee living abroad, whatever their nationality
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee whose home address is in a country other than Switzerland (nationality is not asked of them)
acceptance_criteria.when: they reach the end of the questionnaire, before submitting
acceptance_criteria.then: Lonio shows the permit reminder; it is worded by HR so that a Swiss citizen living abroad, such as Stefan, can see that it does not apply to them

examples.name: Swiss citizen living in Germany, like Stefan (hr_transcript/F-hr_transcript-1a20bb)

acceptance_criteria.title: No reminder for Swiss employees living in Switzerland
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee whose home address is in Switzerland and whose nationality is Switzerland (including dual citizens holding Swiss citizenship)
acceptance_criteria.when: they reach the end of the questionnaire

acceptance_criteria.title: The reminder collects no data
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee reads it and continues
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee is not asked to confirm, answer or upload anything; nothing about the reminder is recorded, and the employee can submit as usual. The permit itself is handed to HR outside Lonio

stories.title: Discard answers that no longer apply on submission
stories.i_want: to go back and change earlier answers without losing what I already typed, while answers to questions that no longer apply are not kept once I submit
stories.so_that: I can correct myself easily, and Lonio keeps no personal data about me that no receiving party needs
stories.priority_reason: Data minimisation is a core constraint of the feature: keeping answers no party needs means holding personal data Lonio must not have.

acceptance_criteria.title: Answers kept while going back and forth
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee who has answered later questions and then changes an earlier answer so that some of those later questions no longer apply
acceptance_criteria.when: they continue filling in the questionnaire before submitting
acceptance_criteria.then: the questions that no longer apply are no longer asked, but their answers are kept, so that if the employee changes the earlier answer back, the earlier input reappears and need not be entered again

acceptance_criteria.title: Inapplicable answers discarded on submission
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee who has answers to questions that no longer apply because of a changed earlier answer
acceptance_criteria.then: only answers to questions that are asked for the final set of answers are recorded; the answers to questions no longer asked are discarded and are not recorded for any receiving party

examples.name: Moved the home address from Switzerland to Germany after answering nationality and canton
Changed civil status from Married to Single after entering the spouse's date of birth
Changed nationality to Switzerland after answering the C permit question and the source tax questions

stories.title: Questionnaire is read-only for the employee after submission
stories.i_want: the questionnaire to be read-only for the employee once submitted, with every derived result always taken from the latest recorded answers
stories.so_that: the answers recorded for the pension fund registration, the source tax tariff code and HR stay consistent, and later changes go through HR
stories.priority_reason: Wrong or stale derived results (e.g. an insurance start date from an old first working day) would give the pension fund or source tax wrong data; HR reports that the first working day often moves.

acceptance_criteria.title: Employee cannot change answers after submission
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee who has submitted the questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.then: they can see their answers but cannot change them; any later change (such as a move, a marriage, a new child, a certificate of residence handed in later, a corrected nationality or a new first working day) is made by HR, which is specified in the later HR-side spec

acceptance_criteria.title: Derived results always come from the latest answers
acceptance_criteria.given: a submitted questionnaire whose answers are later changed (by HR)
acceptance_criteria.when: the insurance start date, the civil status for the pension fund and for source tax, the source tax liability or the tariff code are needed
acceptance_criteria.then: each is derived again from the latest answers; no earlier result and no history of earlier first working days is kept

examples.name: First working day moved from the 15th to the 1st of a month
First working day in the middle of a month

stories.title: Step-by-step questionnaire flow
stories.i_want: to answer one questionnaire in English, step by step in a fixed order, seeing only the steps and questions that apply to me and each question only once
stories.so_that: I give every piece of information once for all receiving parties and am not asked for data no party needs about me
stories.priority_reason: Structures the employee experience; the underlying ask-once and only-when-needed conditions are already required by the individual questions.

acceptance_criteria.title: Steps in a fixed order
acceptance_criteria.given: a new employee starting the questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.then: the steps come in this order: 1 Personal details, 2 Home address (canton only for residents of Switzerland), 3 Start of employment, 4 Nationality and permit, 5 Civil status and spouse, 6 Source tax, 7 Children, 8 Cross-border commuting, 9 Finish (permit reminder, then submission); the questionnaire is in English

acceptance_criteria.title: Steps and questions that do not apply are skipped
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee for whom no question of a step applies (e.g. a Swiss employee living in Switzerland who is not subject to source tax)
acceptance_criteria.then: that step is not shown, and every question is asked at most once and only when a receiving party needs it for this employee

examples.name: Swiss employee living in Switzerland, single

acceptance_criteria.title: Submission only with all required answers
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee at the Finish step
acceptance_criteria.then: submission succeeds only if every question that is asked for them and required has been answered; after submission the answers are recorded for HR and the receiving parties and the questionnaire becomes read-only for the employee
